lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Concept model C: corresponding parts of congruent triangles

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example is written more briefly. Fill in the reasoning it leaves out.

items.prompt: Two sides and the included angle are congruent. Which criterion?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.
The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.
The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.
Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 75° and ∠B = 25°. Find ∠F.
A rigid motion is a transformation that …
choices: preserves area but may change side lengths
preserves shape but may change size
maps every figure to a similar figure

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: In two triangles, the hypotenuses and one pair of legs of two right triangles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and a pair of non-included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 75° and ∠B = 60°. Find ∠F.
Two figures are congruent if and only if …
choices: there is a sequence of rigid motions taking one exactly onto the other
they can be scaled to match

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and the pair of included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.
